source.allocation: independent zero-filled requested-length payload after service delay
source.limitations: Different calibration host and approximately 110-MiB objects. No latency distribution, retries, coalescing, failures, or shared bandwidth model. Arrivals and cache lookups remain unrestricted.

objectives: maximize conditional disk caller hit rate
maximize conditional disk byte hit rate
maximize combined byte hit rate (minimize source downloaded bytes)
minimize disk read plus write bytes
search: Evaluate center and six axial neighbors separately for each mode. Expand untested +/-10% neighbors of each objective's best observed configuration, round-robin across objective leaders. Retain the full Pareto frontier and all metrics, with no scalar aggregate. Stop at exhausted improving leaders or budget. If no valid run in a mode evicts from disk, stop varying its disk cost and use its starting coefficient for subsequent candidates. Do not attribute disk-coefficient-only differences without eviction to that coefficient.
source_identity: Working-tree snapshot and patch hashes recorded under raw before building
